Motorized Shades in Los Angeles, California

Lower a shade at a tall window without reaching for it, or adjust several shades together as the afternoon light changes. At John Crawford Company in Woodland Hills, we help you choose compatible shades and controls, install them and set up the system.

Choose shades and controls that suit your room

Some customers prefer a handheld remote. Others like the app or a control on the wall. We start with the way you want to use the shades, whether that's one window at a time or several together.

Choose the shade style for the light, privacy and look you want. Then we’ll check which motors and controls are available for that style and your window size.

Hunter Douglas PowerView® Automation

PowerView® Automation lets you operate selected Hunter Douglas window treatments with a remote or the PowerView® App. In the app, you can set schedules for the times you want the shades to move.

A PowerView® Gen 3 Gateway is needed for control while you’re away and for supported smart-home connections. We’ll check the accessories needed for the features you want.

The PowerView® App is required for programmed operation.

Power options for motorized shades

Power choices depend on the product. Available options may include replaceable batteries, rechargeable power or a wired connection. For a tall window, the way you reach a battery or charger matters just as much as the control you choose.

If you're building or remodeling, we can talk through power options alongside the window design. We can also discuss the shade requirements with your electrician if electrical work is needed.

Motorized shade installation and support

A motorization job in Santa Rosa Valley

On a new-build project in Santa Rosa Valley, we installed hardwired shades and set up the app controls. When a wiring connection needed attention, we coordinated with an electrician to resolve it and complete the setup.

Help after the shades are installed

We set up the controls and show you how they work at installation. You can also call us with questions afterward.

John has helped customers recalibrate a shade in the app over the phone. If the issue needs a closer look, we can discuss an in-person service visit.

Questions about motorized window treatments

Ask John: (818) 884-5464
Can you motorize shades I already have?

Sometimes. The product, age, condition and available components determine what's possible. Send us the brand and model if you know them, along with photos, so we can review the options.

Will it work with my existing smart-home system?

For PowerView® Gen 3, a Gateway connects the shades with supported smart-home systems. Tell us which system you use and we’ll check the connection and any accessories it needs.

Can I keep a remote as well as an app?

Yes. PowerView® shades can use a compatible remote as well as the PowerView® App. We’ll help you choose the controls you prefer and explain any accessories needed for additional features.

Talk with us about motorization

Tell us which windows you’d like to control more easily. You can schedule a visit to our Woodland Hills showroom or request a free in-home consultation to compare compatible shade and control options.

We also install and set up Somfy motorization for compatible window treatments.
